$comment: Example utterances for mapping natural language to Haven's MCP tools in the Alexa+ console (or whatever surface lets you hint at phrasing — this wasn't confirmed against a live Alexa+ account; see docs/friction-log.md). The tool names and parameters below are authoritative, read from haven/mcp/schemas.py and haven/mcp/tools/*.py — the example_utterances are suggestions, not something the server enforces.

tools.name: get_household_context_tool
tools.summary: Resolve what Haven currently knows about the household for a goal.
example_utterances: what do you know about the house right now
check the house before movie night

tools.name: propose_household_plan_tool
tools.summary: Propose a structured, multi-step plan for a goal. Does not act on anything yet.
example_utterances: help me get ready for movie night
tools.returns: A plan_id, used by get_plan_status_tool and execute_household_plan_tool.

tools.name: get_plan_status_tool
tools.summary: Check a previously proposed plan's status, including execution/verification once run.
example_utterances: what's the status of that plan
did movie night get set up

tools.name: execute_household_plan_tool
tools.summary: Execute a previously proposed plan and verify the result. Set confirmed=true only after the user has explicitly agreed to a plan containing a high-impact step.
tools.requires_confirmation: conditional — only when the plan itself reports requires_confirmation=true; Haven, not Alexa+, decides this per plan

tools.name: save_household_preference_tool
tools.summary: Save a durable household (or person-scoped) preference. Rejects transient state like presence or device status.
example_utterances: we like sci-fi and comedy movies
remember that I don't like horror movies
set the living room as our usual movie room

tools.name: get_activity_recommendations_tool
tools.summary: Suggest up to 3 things to watch tonight based on available time, saved genre preferences, and recent activity. Does not propose or execute a plan.
